note: Thailand: a foreigner works on a work permit. Urgent and necessary work, notified to the registrar, is allowed for up to 15 days, extendable by 15 (Tilleke & Gibbins on the 2017 Royal Decree), and the Department of Employment's list of urgent work now includes an international music festival or concert supported by government agencies (Envoy Global); being open only to government-supported events, like Belgium's and Denmark's exemptions for major events, it isn't modelled as days open to a performer.

sources.title: Envoy Global, Thailand: Updates for the Urgent Work Permit Category
sources.said: The government of Thailand updated the Department of Employment’s list of activities that qualify for an Urgent Work Permit (UWP) or Ad-hoc work designation. ... Item (13) Work supported by government agencies: (a) Mega event organization or international festival (b) International music festival or concert

sources.title: Tilleke & Gibbins, Relaxation of Work Permit Requirements in Thailand
sources.said: Urgent and necessary work, which was previously strictly limited to not more than 15 days, is now extendable for up to 15 days if such work by the foreigner is not finished in time. Notification to the registrar is required,
